thread:
sahil: Ok kicking off a short thread to scope the Optimize Toolkit + Evals effort for Q3. Goal: give customers clear, low-friction batching & caching recommendations + automated regression alerts tied to prompt sets.

maya: +1. Need to be explicit about launch criteria. My draft: (1) actionable config suggestions for 3 common workloads (chat, embed, rerank), (2) regression detector that flags ~95% of eval regressions on our seed prompt set, and (3) beta with 2 customers. Thoughts? :thinking_face:

jess: Those are solid. One question: do we ship static heuristics first (rule-based batch thresholds) or go straight for a telemetry-driven tuner?

sahil: MVP = static heuristics + clear operator guide. Phase 2 = telemetry tuner + automated rollout. Keeps risk low.

kevin: Agree. Also needs minimal instrumentation: per-route avg seq len, inter-arrival hist, success/error rates. Can we reuse existing Console traces?

anna: We can. I can add a small telemetry export in the runtime that opt-bot consumes. ETA 2 weeks for a stub.

opt-bot: perf-summary: sample payloads + seq_len distribution available via /internal/opt/telemetry (auth required).

jess: For evals/regressions: propose we pick 200 prompts across 4 verticals (docs QA, chat assistant, customer support, search rerank). Each prompt has golden metric + threshold. Regression pipeline should auto-run daily on master and on model rollouts.

maya: Agree on prompt set size. Launch criteria for regression: false positive rate < 10% on our manual checks, time-to-detect < 24h.

sahil: Customer asks: Product A wants explicit caching recommendations for session-based agents. Product B wants per-route fallback policies that switch to cheaper quantized models when latency SLOs are hit. Can we accommodate both in MVP?

kevin: We can cover caching guidance (LRU prefix cache heuristics + TTL) in doc + a proto config:
```
cache: 
  mode: prefix_kv
  ttl_sec: 300
  max_prefix_tokens: 64
```
But fallback routing touches smart-routing layer; MVP doc + example policy should be fine, full auto-fallback in Phase 2.

anna: Ops note: need to surface cost impact estimates for each rec. We should compute token savings estimates assuming average seq len and hit rates. I can add a calculator widget in Console UI v1.

maya: Prioritization: 1) static batching heuristics + guide, 2) prefix caching guide + calculator, 3) regression eval infra + seed prompt sets, 4) telemetry-driven tuner + auto-fallback. Is that everyone’s order?

jess: Yea, but swap 2/3 if regressions require dataset work that blocks other items. We should map dependencies.

sahil: Action items: Maya to own success criteria + launch doc (due 1 week). Jess to lead prompt-selection + eval rules (due 2 weeks). Kevin + Anna to deliver telemetry stub and cache config examples (stub 2w, examples 3w). I'll own roadmap + customer comms.

maya: Added — will create a short PRD and link to this thread.

jess: I'll start assembling the 200 prompts. Quick ask: tag prompts with vertical and intended metric (perplexity / num_correct / MRR).

kevin: For rollout, suggest canary on 5% traffic for 48h with auto-rollback on regression signal. Document that.

opt-bot: reminder: weekly Optimize sync Thu 11am — will add agenda item for launch criteria review.

sahil: Great. Last Q: do we need an explicit privacy review for prompt telemetry? Anna?

anna: Short answer: yes. We'll keep payloads hashed and only store sequence-length + feature aggregates, not raw user content. I'll loop in security.

maya: Perfect. Meeting invite after PRD done. Thanks everyone. :raised_hands:
